story_text:
RISE Checkpoint
Stop snoozing. Start rising.
Meet RISE Checkpoint — the simple, affordable way to take control of your mornings.
Tired of hitting snooze, losing time and rushing to start your day? RISE Checkpoint makes getting out of bed part of the alarm itself.
Using simple NFC technology, RISE Checkpoint is a compact puck you place wherever you need to be in the morning. To turn off your alarm, you have to physically get up and tap your phone against it.
No batteries. No complicated setup. Just a reason to get moving.
Waterproof, designed in Scotland and built to make better mornings accessible to everyone, RISE Checkpoint turns your intention to get up into action.
Because your morning shouldn’t start with another snooze.
RISE Checkpoint — Your alarm won’t stop until you do.
Rise checkpoint alarms main aim is to bring reliable checkpoint based phone alarms into the homes of the masses by delivering a sound product at an affordable price,
Many other companies offering similar products are over charging for this nfc technology rise aims to reduce that barrier to entry.
Rise is based in Aberdeen Scotland and all production and packaging takes place here by myself - Lewis Harper
My main reason to use kickstarter is to fund designing and producing the first prototypes I should have v1 ready to test in 4 days once my order of nfc chips arrives
Product Specifications
The device is now a solid-state, highly durable tactile puck designed for lifetime placement anywhere in your home.
- Dimensions and Enclosure: 75 mm x 75 mm x 15 mm. The ultra-low profile allows it to blend seamlessly into a nightstand, bathroom mirror, or kitchen wall. It is 3D-printed using premium Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polycarbonate (PC-CF) or High-Density Matte PETG for a pristine, tactile finish.
- Internal Core: It contains absolutely no wiring, batteries, or active electronics. Instead, a high-frequency NFC NTAG213 / NTAG215 microchip with a fine copper antenna loop is permanently encapsulated inside the plastic matrix.
- Premium Weighting: Since there are no heavy electronics, the internal cavity is backfilled with a high-density eco-resin compound or metallic weights during the print process. This gives the 75x75mm puck a satisfying, premium desk weight (approx. 150g) and prevents it from shifting. It can also be configured with an optional integrated wall mount or adhesive backing.
How It Works with Your Phone (The "Off Switch" Logic)
The entire intelligence of the system lives within the Rise Clock App on your phone, turning the passive puck into a physical gatekeeper.
- The Lockout Alarm: You set your wake-up time in the Rise Clock App (iOS 15+ / Android 10+). When the alarm triggers, the app initiates a hardware lockout screen, preventing you from simply minimizing the app or lowering the volume.
- The Passive Handshake: To silence the alarm, you must get out of bed and touch your phone's NFC sweet spot directly against the 75x75mm Rise Checkpoint.
- Magnetic Induction Power: The moment your phone gets within 2–3 centimeters of the puck, your phone’s internal NFC module radiates a tiny RF field. The checkpoint's internal copper antenna harvests this wireless energy to instantly power up the embedded microchip.
- Instant Dismissal: The powered chip transmits a unique, securely encrypted cryptographic signature back to the app. The app verifies the signature, confirms you are physically standing at your designated checkpoint, and immediately shuts off the alarm.
Ultra-Streamlined Production Plan (High-Velocity Print Farm)
Manufacturing a completely passive product eliminates 90% of traditional hardware pitfalls (sourcing silicon, custom PCBs, assembly errors, and battery safety shipping restrictions).
- Phase 1: Engineering Validation Testing (EVT): Print 10 test pucks with varying top-plate layer thicknesses (ranging from 0.8mm to 1.6mm). We will test different smartphones to determine the exact depth that maximizes NFC read speeds through the 3D-printed filament.
- Phase 2: Design Validation Testing (DVT): Print a pilot run of 100 units on the 3D printing farm. We optimize the automated "Pause-at-Layer" script. The printer pauses mid-print, the operator drops the passive NFC chip and the internal ballast weights into the open pocket, and the printer finishes the job, completely sealing the components inside a seamless solid block.
- Phase 3: Production Validation Testing (PVT): Maximize bed density. Because the pucks are only 15mm tall and require zero electrical assembly, a single industrial 3D printer can output a high-density grid of 25 finished units per batch.
- Phase 4: Mass Production (MP): Run the 3D printing farm at 24/7 capacity. Post-processing requires a simple automated vapor-smoothing line to give the matte finish its premium look, followed directly by retail boxing.
Accelerated 4-Month Delivery Timeline
Because the product requires zero electrical compliance certifications (no FCC, CE, or battery transport restrictions are required for a completely passive NFC tag), the time-to-market is compressed to an elite 4-month window:
TimelineMilestoneKey Focus Areas
Month 1
EVT & App Development
Optimize print-depth penetration for the NFC chip; complete the core alarm-blocking app architecture for iOS/Android.
Month 2
DVT & App Optimization
Print 100 pilot pucks; refine the internal weight balancing; launch the beta app to TestFlight and Google Play.
Month 3
Mass Production (MP1)
Scale the 3D printing farm to output the first batch of 5,000 units; print eco-friendly, compact retail packaging.
Month 4
Logistics & Launch
Final automated surface smoothing, boxing, app store public deployment, and direct-to-customer shipping.
